subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the UN?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The State Council**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The United Nations (UN) is an international organization founded in **1945**.
 
• It is currently made up of **193 Member States**.
 
• The main organs of the UN are:
 
 
• **The General Assembly:** The main deliberative, policymaking, and representative organ.
 
• **The Security Council:** Responsible for maintaining international peace and security.
 
• **The International Court of Justice:** The principal judicial organ of the UN.
 
• **The Secretariat:** Carries out the day-to-day work of the UN.
 
• **The Economic and Social Council:** Promotes international economic and social cooperation and development.
 
• **The Trusteeship Council:** Currently inactive, was established to oversee the administration of trust territories.
 
 
 
• The State Council is not an organ of the United Nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Security Council**

 
 
• It has **15 members**: **5 permanent members (China, France, Russian Federation, the United Kingdom, and the United States) **and **10 non-permanent members **elected for two-year terms by the General Assembly.
 
• Each member has one vote. Decisions on procedural matters are made by an affirmative vote of at least 9 of the 15 members.
 
• Decisions on substantive matters require 9 votes, including the concurring votes of all five permanent members.
 
 
 
• **The International Court of Justice**
 
 
• Located in **The Hague, Netherlands**.
 
• The court settles legal disputes between states and gives advisory opinions on international legal issues referred to it by the UN.
 
 
 
• **The General Assembly**
 
 
• All 193 Member States of the UN are represented in the General Assembly, making it the only UN body with universal representation.
 
• Each year in September, the full UN membership meets in the General Assembly Hall in New York for the annual General Assembly session, and general debate, which many heads of state attend and address.
